name: Contraste esencial
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset: one complete isolated menu-and-box design board for the real ISyCode terminal coding assistant.
Create realistic, production-quality UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong monospace typography and purposeful spacing.
TARGET: one high-resolution landscape image, 3840 x 2160 pixels. This is a component contact sheet, NOT the full app screen. The user explicitly requests all menus together in ONE image per design direction. This overrides a generic single-screen/hero-only brief. Render exactly ONE coherent direction on this sheet, not several style alternatives.
REFERENCE IMAGES: Five actual user screenshots are attached as visual context: first Settings, second preferred HIGH CONTRAST sidebar, third HIGH CONTRAST Authority, fourth Models, fifth Multi Harness. All seven supplied screenshots were inspected; five were selected for the tool's attachment limit, prioritizing Settings and high contrast. These are reference material, NOT edit targets. Redesign their menus together, do not paste a collage of the old screenshots. Exclude all OS bars, terminal tabs, desktop docks, window controls, wallpaper, landscape banner, cat and main chat scene. Only isolated menus and boxes on a neutral dark board with generous gutters, no overlaps. The main screenshot composition happens later after selection.
SURFACE: Textual TUI, fixed monospace cell alignment. No web dashboard, no mobile mockup, no glass, blur, gradients, shadows, bevels or huge rounded corners. Terminal-feasible thin rules, aligned text rows, tiny corner radii at most. Normal UI labels about 24px on this large sheet, headings 30px. Body legible and crisp. No clipped labels or fake gibberish. UI in Spanish except real proper names ISyCode, IsySentinel, MCP, LSP, Multi Harness, NVIDIA NIM, GLM 5.3. All panels share the exact same title hierarchy, border language, row selection, fields, buttons and shortcut footer.
PRIORITIES: Settings must be the largest and most developed component, occupying about one fifth of the sheet. Remove category names repeated at every row. Group them once. Sidebar must be considerably cleaner, with section headings and dividers rather than boxes inside boxes. All menus look like one product.
COMPOSITION: balanced three horizontal bands. Upper band about 800px tall contains large Settings, two narrower tall sidebar specimens Overview and Files, compact Providers and Models stacked, and Authority. Middle band contains Multi Harness, Sessions, Review diff, Approve command, and a Text/copy interaction specimen. Lower band contains Connections form, Journal/detail, Welcome/mode, command palette/role/context selectors, Ideas/queue, and retained command output/processes. You may adjust widths to keep clean gutters and readable text. Everything is completely visible.
REQUIRED BOXES (17 menu families, may show related states together under one heading):
- Configuración / Settings: search field. Categories Conversación, Preferencias, Permisos, Conexiones. Values right-aligned and explanations separated from labels. Show Proveedor NVIDIA NIM, Modelo GLM 5.3, Razonamiento Automático, Rol Programador; preferences Alto contraste ON, Sonidos ON, Solo ASCII OFF. Clear category navigation, short contextual description and consistent Back/Close controls.
- Sidebar Overview: Workspace heading, Resumen / Archivos navigation, IsySentinel summary, MCP Sin configurar, LSP Pyright Listo and rust-analyzer No disponible, Skills, Conexiones. Meaningful text plus semantic status, no huge colored blocks or nested frames.
- Sidebar Files: Archivos, Buscar archivo, src/helper.py selected in a simple tree, a genuinely useful code preview showing def helper(): and return 2, explicit Abrir / Copiar ruta actions.
- Proveedores: small searchable list NVIDIA NIM (Actual), OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter; chosen provider has a precise state cue and description. No orange selection unrelated to the design.
- Modelos: list GLM 5.3 (Actual), GLM 5.3 Flash, Kimi; selected model details separate, one clear Elegir action. Metadata example is illustrative, no price/capacity promises.
- Authority & Security: current Classic visible, Cambiar modo action. Leer archivos ON, Editar archivos ON, Comandos en sandbox ON, Copiar texto ON, Integraciones OFF. Small legible note 'Editar y ejecutar requieren aprobación'. Do not imply Classic bypasses approval or all tools get enabled by UI selection.
- Multi Harness: aligned simple rows CODEX, CLAUDE, QWEN, CRUSH, with Listo / No disponible, details below and a Revisar propuesta action.
- Sesiones: Buscar conversación, + Nueva conversación, selected Reparar pruebas, secondary Refactor helper; show details and Abrir, no personal data or real dates.
- Revisar edición: helper.py, a short real-looking diff -return 1 +return 2, Alcance: este archivo, buttons Cancelar / Aprobar.
- Aprobar comando: python -m unittest -q, sandbox scope, Revisar antes de ejecutar, Cancelar / Ejecutar.
- Texto y copia specimen: content box with FOUR lines of code but EXACTLY TWO consecutive lines visually highlighted as a mouse text selection. Nearby small copy popover 'Copiar selección · 2 líneas' and 'Copiar caja completa'. Show the tooltip 'Space: expandir · Doble clic: copiar'. The popover is an intentional anchored child of this specimen; no other panel overlaps. Clearly distinguish selected text from the rest.
- Conexiones form: gateway host placeholder localhost, clave masked as dots, MCP status Sin conectar, compact Revisar conexión action. No exposed secrets.
- Journal / detalle: 2 short event rows Lectura ALLOW and Comando ALLOW, selected receipt details, Verificar.
- Bienvenida / modo: short explanation, Classic and Security choices, no overwhelming intro wall. Controls always visible.
- Comandos / rol / contexto: searchable command palette with Configuración, Abrir archivo, Elegir rol; a small selector uses the same row/detail template.
- Ideas / cola: current idea readable, two short queued messages; controls Revisar / Editar in the same language.
- Salida / procesos: python -m unittest -q, Listo · exit 0, two readable output lines, retained receipt area, footer 'Space: expandir'.
CONTENT/INTERACTION INVARIANTS: Simple click only focuses a text box; ONLY Space expands content boxes; double click opens copy menu, never expands. Drag highlights exact text; Copiar selección copies only that range. Buttons have obvious distinct focus and selection states. Space in editable fields remains a typed space. Keyboard footers for menu lists can use '↑↓ mover · Enter elegir · Esc volver'; content boxes use 'Space expandir · Doble clic copiar'. Copy popover never suggests a plain click copies all.
Use spacing, alignment, grouping and typography first; dividers second; subtle tint only where useful; sparse consistent borders. No individual list-row cards. No made-up metrics, charts, features, large icons or marketing copy.
Current date anchor: 11 October 2026. Omit dates from mock content unless necessary. Preserve existing functionality semantics; this is a visual proposal, not a running product.

DIRECTION: Contraste esencial. Black #000000 panel surfaces, near-white #f8fafc primary text, #aeb8c4 secondary text, one quiet #9aa3ad perimeter rule. Cyan #22d3ee ONLY for focus/selection marker and active navigation, not every heading. Green/yellow/red reserved for state plus written labels. Flat, calm, spare terminal UI with consistent thin gray rounded-rectangle borders. Settings uses a LEFT category index with four short labels and a RIGHT detail list for the selected Conversación section; no long all-category table. Sidebar is a single flat surface divided into sections, three-line summaries before expansion. Other menus use the same small header and bottom key-hint strip. Highlight selected row with a tiny cyan vertical marker and subtle charcoal fill. No saturated backgrounds. A visually quiet minimalist high-contrast direction that looks like the existing ISyCode high contrast made coherent.
